<document id="card-controls">
CardˆcontrolsˆCardˆcontrolsˆletˆyouˆdecideˆwhereˆyourˆcardˆcanˆbeˆused.ˆChangesˆtakeˆeffectˆstraightˆaway.ˆ##ˆControlsˆyouˆcanˆsetˆInˆtheˆapp,ˆtapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆControls.ˆYouˆcanˆswitchˆeachˆofˆtheseˆonˆorˆoff:ˆ-ˆOnlineˆpurchasesˆ-ˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆ(inˆstoresˆandˆonlineˆwithˆforeignˆmerchants)ˆ-ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆ-ˆContactlessˆpaymentsˆ##ˆCommonˆmix-upsˆ-ˆAˆdeclinedˆonlineˆorderˆfromˆaˆforeignˆwebsiteˆisˆoftenˆtheˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆcontrol,ˆnotˆtheˆOnlineˆpurchasesˆone.ˆ-ˆSwitchingˆoffˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆonˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆdoesn'tˆaffectˆyourˆvirtualˆcard,ˆwhichˆcan'tˆbeˆusedˆatˆATMsˆanyway.ˆ-ˆControlsˆdon'tˆchangeˆyourˆlimits.ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆyourˆplan.ˆ##ˆControlsˆversusˆfreezingˆControlsˆblockˆcertainˆkindsˆofˆtransactions.ˆFreezingˆblocksˆalmostˆeverything.ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyourˆcardˆisˆatˆrisk,ˆfreezeˆit.ˆSupportˆcanˆexplainˆyourˆcurrentˆsettings,ˆbutˆyouˆchangeˆcontrolsˆyourselfˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
WhatˆchangedˆinˆtheˆMarchˆ2026ˆfeeˆupdateˆWeˆupdatedˆourˆfeesˆonˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆHere'sˆeverythingˆthatˆchangedˆandˆwhatˆstayedˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangedˆ-ˆ**Plusˆmonthlyˆfee:**ˆfromˆ$4.00ˆtoˆ$5.00.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆfromˆ1.5%ˆtoˆ1%.ˆ-ˆ**Out-of-networkˆATMˆfeeˆonˆBasicˆandˆPlus:**ˆfromˆ$2.00ˆtoˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Plusˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawals:**ˆfromˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstayedˆtheˆsameˆBasicˆisˆstillˆfree.ˆPremiumˆisˆstillˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonthˆwithˆnoˆATMˆorˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees.ˆCardˆreplacement,ˆwireˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfeesˆdidn'tˆchangeˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ##ˆWhyˆweˆmadeˆtheseˆchangesˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆoperatorsˆraisedˆwhatˆtheyˆchargeˆus,ˆandˆweˆmovedˆpartˆofˆthatˆcostˆintoˆtheˆfee.ˆWeˆloweredˆtheˆPlusˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆatˆtheˆsameˆtime,ˆsoˆPlusˆmembersˆwhoˆtravelˆpayˆlessˆoverall.ˆIfˆtheˆnewˆPlusˆpriceˆdoesn'tˆworkˆforˆyou,ˆyouˆcanˆmoveˆtoˆBasicˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTheˆchangeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="disputes-unauthorized">
Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆIfˆyouˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆorˆauthorize,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆitˆasˆunauthorized.ˆ##ˆFirst,ˆprotectˆyourˆcardˆBeforeˆweˆopenˆanˆunauthorizedˆdispute,ˆtheˆcardˆusedˆmustˆbeˆfrozenˆorˆreportedˆlostˆorˆstolen.ˆThatˆstopsˆmoreˆchargesˆwhileˆweˆinvestigate.ˆIfˆtheˆcardˆisˆstillˆinˆyourˆwallet,ˆfreezingˆisˆenough.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆyouˆhaveˆReportˆanˆunauthorizedˆtransactionˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆdateˆofˆtheˆstatementˆitˆfirstˆappearedˆon.ˆStatementsˆcloseˆonˆtheˆlastˆcalendarˆdayˆofˆeachˆmonth.ˆForˆexample,ˆaˆtransactionˆthatˆpostedˆinˆMarchˆappearsˆonˆtheˆMarchˆstatement,ˆsoˆtheˆwindowˆrunsˆfromˆtheˆendˆofˆMarch.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆIfˆyourˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆMostˆinvestigationsˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆForeignˆtransactions,ˆandˆaccountsˆopenˆlessˆthanˆ30ˆdays,ˆcanˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆYourˆliabilityˆYouˆaren'tˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆreportedˆwithinˆtheˆwindow.ˆ##ˆNotˆsureˆit'sˆunauthorized?ˆUnfamiliarˆnamesˆareˆoftenˆaˆmerchant'sˆparentˆcompanyˆorˆaˆpaymentˆprocessor.ˆTapˆtheˆtransactionˆtoˆseeˆtheˆmerchant'sˆdetailsˆbeforeˆyouˆdisputeˆit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
